title: UX/Product Designer
description: Design intuitive user experiences, conduct user research, create interactive wireframes and prototypes, and build scalable design systems.

nodes.title: UI & Visual Fundamentals
nodes.description: Master typography, color theory, grid systems, layout balance, and visual hierarchy.

nodes.title: User Research & Personas
nodes.description: Conduct user interviews, synthesize research data, build user personas, and map customer journey maps.

nodes.title: Information Architecture & Card Sorting
nodes.description: Structure navigation flows, sitemaps, information hierarchy, and card sorting exercises.

nodes.title: Wireframing & Figma Mastery
nodes.description: Create low-fidelity and high-fidelity wireframes using Figma, auto-layout, components, and variant sets.

nodes.title: Usability Testing & Feedback Loops
nodes.description: Conduct moderated and unmoderated usability tests, analyze heatmaps, and iterate based on feedback.

nodes.title: Design Systems & Capstone Portfolio
nodes.description: Build tokenized design systems, component libraries, design handoff documentation, and present a portfolio.
